responseText: Good. We'll start with the basics: a stone weapon mold. The mold is the foundation of any weapon. Source some basalt, or granite, and head over to that armorer's bench. There, craft a stone weapon mold. Make it capacious! More metal for your mettle, if you follow me. Show me when you're done.
